sentences.text: Purranisaurus was a medium-sized marine reptile that grew to a length of about 3.3 meters.
The genus was originally described by Rusconi in 1948.
Gasparini later demonstrated that Purranisaurus is a metriorhynchid crocodyliform, a group of semi-aquatic reptiles.
Phylogenetic analyses in the 2000s confirmed Purranisaurus as a distinct metriorhynchid genus.
The animal belongs to the subfamily Geosaurinae.
The type species, P. potens, lived during the Late Jurassic in Argentina.
Another species, P. casamiquelai, lived during the Middle Jurassic in Chile.
A third species, P. westermanni, also lived during the Middle Jurassic in Chile.
A subsequent study expanded the genus to include the species Metriorhynchus casamiquelai and M. westermanni.
Purranisaurus lived in marine environments in Chile and Argentina during the Middle to Late Jurassic periods.
The time range for Purranisaurus is estimated from 145.06 to 141 million years ago.
It is debated whether Purranisaurus potens is a junior synonym of Metriorhynchus.
